messages:
mira: Heads-up — prepping private installer + image bundle for Customer-APAC (airgapped). Target package: redwood-private-installer-v2.2.0-priv.
mira: Proposed change window: Thu 2026-03-28 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need image-digest pinning, SHA checksums for the tarball, and confirmation that the airgap install smoke test passes in staging.
deploy-bot: Package created: redwood-private-installer-v2.2.0-priv.tar.gz (bundle-id: bndl-20260322-7f3a). Images baked: redwood/runtime:2.2.0-priv (sha256:3a7f9b5c...), redwood/loader:1.8.1 (sha256:9f1c2d4e...). Release artifacts pushed to s3://redwood-private-releases/bndl-20260322-7f3a/.
alex: Can we make sure we pin by digest only in the installer manifest? No relying on tags for production installs — tags move.
mira: yes — installer manifest will reference digests. sample manifest snippet:
```
images:
  - name: redwood/runtime
    digest: sha256:3a7f9b5c9e8d2c4ab...
  - name: redwood/loader
    digest: sha256:9f1c2d4e5b6a7c8d...
```
alex: also update the README with how to verify digests during airgap transfer.
rui: migration note — v2.2.0 adds optional schema change (activity_index). It's BACKWARDS compatible and idempotent; we run migration as post-install step with `--safe-rollout`.
ops-oncall: Rollback plan: if installer fails on >10% hosts or post-install smoke >30m error, rollback to v2.1.9. We should keep v2.1.9 images available in the airgap bundle and tag them in the manifest so quick revert is just swapping manifest and redeploy. Also we need a routing hold: set policy to pin to old runtime for affected tenants.
sam: I'll prepare the customer delivery checklist + release notes. Items: artifact checksum, install guide, known issues, rollback steps, contact oncall. Leaving a placeholder for the change window in the ticket.
alex: can someone run the sha256sum and paste it here before we hand off to partner? I'll validate after transfer.
mira: local sha256s: `sha256sum redwood-private-installer-v2.2.0-priv.tar.gz` -> `d4c3b2a1f9e8d7c6b5a4f3e2d1c0b9a8f7e6d5c4b3a2910f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1`. Please confirm CRC on S3/partner side.
ops-oncall: Confirmed on staging pull: sha256 matches d4c3b2a1f9e8d7c6b5a4f3e2d1c0b9a8f7e6d5c4b3a2910f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1 :white_check_mark:
mira: airgap transfer preference? S3 presigned + customer pulls from secure channel, or partner FTP?
sam: Customer prefers SFTP. I'll arrange an endpoint and give them the checksums and install checklist.
rui: Quick request — run the airgap smoke script in staging before handoff: `./hack/airgap_smoke.sh --bundle bndl-20260322-7f3a` — it verifies image import + service start.
alex: assigning to @ops-oncall to run the smoke test and report back within 24h. If green, we'll schedule the change window and tag the release as "ready-for-delivery".
ops-oncall: Running smoke now in staging, will post results here.
deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: 2026-03-28T02:00:00Z -> apply manifest pin, deploy. To cancel: react with :x: or post `cancel rollout`. To rollback: post `rollback v2.1.9`.
ops-oncall: Smoke finished — all checks passed (import, services up, basic inference). Logs: small warning on loader config default but non-blocking. Marking ready-for-delivery.
mira: thanks — Sam, please proceed with SFTP delivery and attach the release notes + checksum. Alex, leave the manifest pin as final in the release branch.
sam: Done — SFTP endpoint handed off, customer confirmed receipt and checksum. Closing loop.
alex: I'll push the manifest pin commit and tag release `v2.2.0-priv-20260322` after CI green.
mira: Great. Final ask: keep this thread live during the change window and post any rollback triggers here.
